'''Suwantek Systems''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]-based corporation that produced the [[TL-1200 transport/Legends|TL-1200 transport]] and the [[TL-1800 light freighter/Legends|TL-1800 light freighter]].
